description: A Kivy-based Python application demonstrating an experimental SmoothLine feature with interactive sliders, buttons, and animated sine/cosine wave lines.

classes.name: LinePlayground
classes.description: A FloatLayout subclass providing interactive line drawing, animation, and UI controls for line properties.

classes.name: TestLineApp
classes.description: Main application class that builds and runs the LinePlayground interface.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events to add points to the line.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Updates the last point position during touch move events.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events to ungrab the touch.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Starts or stops the line animation based on user interaction.

methods.name: update_points_animation
methods.description: Updates the line points to animate sine and cosine wave patterns.
